newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus postpones debate on Rifkind visit.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus postpones debate on Rifkind visit.

text.p: Cypriot President Glafcos Clerides said politicians were postponing an all-party meeting scheduled for Wednesday to discuss a controversial planned visit to Cyprus by British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind.

Three political parties have expressed concern at Rifkind's intention of visiting Turkish Cypriot leader Rauf Denktash in the north, fearing this could imply British recognition of the breakaway Turkish Cypriot state there.
Rifkind, due on the island on Monday, will have discussions with both Greek and Turkish Cypriots focusing on prospects for achieving a negotiated settlement on Cyprus, divided since 1974.
Clerides said Wednesday's all-party meeting of the national council had been postponed because he has bronchitis.
